description: This source file contains utility functions related to symlink detection, path matching, cache management for filesystem stat calls, and directory removal handling in a version control context. It provides mechanisms to cache filesystem checks and manage scheduled directory deletions?

methods.name: int longest_path_match(const char * name_a,int len_a,const char * name_b,int len_b,int * previous_slash)
methods.description: Determines the length of the longest common prefix path match between two file path strings and the position of the previous slash.

methods.name: int lstat_cache_matchlen(struct cache_def * cache,const char * name,int len,int * ret_flags,int track_flags,int prefix_len_stat_func)
methods.description: Checks if a path matches the cache and partially or fully caches filesystem path component status such as directory, symlink, or non-existent.

methods.name: int lstat_cache(struct cache_def * cache,const char * name,int len,int track_flags,int prefix_len_stat_func)
methods.description: Wraps lstat_cache_matchlen to retrieve cache flags for a given path.

methods.name: int threaded_has_symlink_leading_path(struct cache_def * cache,const char * name,int len)
methods.description: Checks if the path has a leading symlink component using cached info.

methods.name: int has_symlink_leading_path(const char * name,int len)
methods.description: Checks for a leading symlink on a path, using the default cache.

methods.name: int check_leading_path(const char * name,int len,int warn_on_lstat_err)
methods.description: Checks if the leading component of a path is a symlink or does not exist, with optional warnings.

methods.name: int threaded_check_leading_path(struct cache_def * cache,const char * name,int len,int warn_on_lstat_err)
methods.description: Checks if the first component of a path exists and is a directory, or if it errors.

methods.name: int has_dirs_only_path(const char * name,int len,int prefix_len)
methods.description: Verifies that all path components exist as directories.

methods.name: int threaded_has_dirs_only_path(struct cache_def * cache,const char * name,int len,int prefix_len)
methods.description: Checks all path components are directories, considering cache for optimization.

methods.name: void schedule_dir_for_removal(const char * name,int len)
methods.description: Schedules directories for removal, handling nested directory structures.

methods.name: void remove_scheduled_dirs(void)
methods.description: Removes all directories scheduled for removal.

methods.name: void invalidate_lstat_cache(void)
methods.description: Resets the internal cache for filesystem stat checks.

methods.name: int lstat_cache_aware_rmdir(const char * path)
methods.description: Removes a directory and invalidates cache if successful.
